summary: The bad flow reads a filename from a properties file in 22b.badSource() and passes it unchecked into `new File(root + data)` in 22a.bad(), allowing `../` sequences to escape the uploads directory (CWE-23). I add a canonical-path containment check in the sink: the resolved file must reside under the intended uploads root, otherwise an IOException is raised. Legitimate filenames within the uploads directory continue to work unchanged.
